violations.reason: PR #72 implements contrast ratio verification calibrated only to WCAG AA minimum threshold (4.5:1, WCAG_AA_MIN_RATIO = 4.5), directly violating the client specification requiring APCA/WCAG AAA contrast (minimum 7:1 to background). Testing against a lower standard provides false compliance assurance against client requirements.

tests/accessibility/theme-contrast.test.ts tests an internal in-memory mock RuntimeThemeManager and hardcoded fixture tokens (themeVariants) rather than auditing real generated CSS/DOM tokens from DesignTokenCompiler or actual semantic layout outputs.
